criterion: P2-001 menu shell (F38-F41 #1), UI lane request 21 Oct 2026
author: Claude (coordinator), owner-authorized Meshy use (Standing owner direction 1, 15 Oct 2026)
workflow: Meshy image-to-image (nano-banana-pro, 16:9, references as data URIs, downscaled to 1536 px) -> inspected -> centre strip cropped to 8:1 and resized to 2400x300 (LANCZOS)
crop: full width, rows 298-470 of the 1376x768 output (centre 8:1 strip), resized to 2400x300
integration_flag: flag-off until the UI lane's code-blind judging passes
palette_check: inspected: no red/crimson/maroon/oxblood; no text, characters or UI

meadows.prompt: Wide panoramic painted landscape for a video game menu banner, painterly key-art style exactly like the first reference image (stylised Palworld / Animo creature-collecting RPG, soft warm light, hand-painted brushwork, clean readable shapes, project palette). The whole scene sits in ONE long horizontal band across the vertical middle of the image (the horizon and all landmarks between 35 and 65 percent of the height), with only plain soft sky above and plain soft ground below, so the image can be cropped to a thin 8:1 strip through the middle. The LEFT 40 percent is calm, simple and slightly darker (low detail, space for a title); detail and landmarks gather toward the RIGHT. No text, no letters, no logos, no characters, no creatures, no people, no UI, no frame or border. Absolutely no red, crimson, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Scene: The Meadows — rolling green meadows with wildflowers, a cosy village of stone-and-timber cottages with blue-grey roofs on the right, a winding dirt road through the grass, distant soft blue hills under a gentle morning sky.
